NPC.NAME: Breahley
NPC.InitialSpeach: Hello, how can I help you today?

Questions.QUESTION: This place is messy, you still getting setup?
Questions.RESPONSE: Yes, sorry about the mess. I working sun to sun down to get this place in order.

Questions.QUESTION: What's good around here?
Questions.RESPONSE: Everything of course, but my favorite are my home grown pumpkins. They make the best pie!

Questions.QUESTION: Have you by chance seen my sister, Neely?
Questions.RESPONSE: I am not sure I know what she looks like, so I can't say that I have.

Questions.QUESTION: How do you know Mira?
Questions.RESPONSE: We met at the library. Have you been there yet, always great knowledge to be had!
